PopoverRoot.description: Holds the popover's open state and shares it with the parts inside it.

props.open: Whether the popover is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the popover.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the popover is open at first, when it isn't controlled.

PopoverTrigger.description: The button that opens and closes the popover. The browser's `popovertarget` does both on a press.

PopoverPopup.description: The popup: an element with `popover="auto"`, placed against the trigger with CSS anchor positioning. Style it with `:popover-open`, `::backdrop` and `@starting-style`.

props.alignOffset: How far the popup is moved along the trigger's edge from its `align` position, in pixels.

PopoverTitle.description: A heading that names the popup. The popup's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

PopoverDescription.description: A paragraph that describes the popup. The popup's `aria-describedby` points at it.

PopoverClose.description: A button that closes the popover.

PopoverArrow.description: An element placed on the popup's edge that faces the trigger, centred on the trigger. It follows the popup when the browser flips it. Give it a shape in CSS and turn it per `data-side`.

dataAttributes.data-side: Which side of the trigger the popup is on. Absent while the popup is closed.
